title: (RHBA-2022:8511) Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation 4.10.8 Bug Fix Update
portal_summary: Updated images that fix several bugs and enhancements are now available for Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation 4.10.8 on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 from Red Hat Container Registry.
portal_synopsis: Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation 4.10.8 Bug Fix Update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|4|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation for IBM Power, little endian|4|ppc64le
Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation for IBM Z and LinuxONE|4|s390x
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation is software-defined storage integrated with and optimized for the Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation. Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation is a highly scalable, production-grade persistent storage for stateful applications running in the Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform. In addition to persistent storage, Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation provisions a multicloud data management service with an S3 compatible API.

Enhancement:

* With this update, you can add settings to rotate the logs file according to the `periodicity` and maximum log size. In the storageCluster Custom Resource (CR), you can add the LogCollector attribute inside the spec which contains fields such as `enable`, `maxLogSize`, and `periodicity`. The `enable` field helps to enable or disable the log collector. The `maxLogSize` helps to rotate the log after the assigned size and the minimum value is 500M. The `periodicity` field helps to set the time interval at which it will rotate and the valid input values are `daily`, `hourly`, `weekly`, and `monthly`. If both the `maxLogSize` and `periodicity` are set, whichever occurs first is given more priority. (BZ#2120268)
